
===== scenario: A-tun-bypass-client-only (start) =====
uci -q show dhcp.@dnsmasq[0]
config_load homeproxy
sing-box version -n
uname -r
ip route show default
ip -6 route show default
ifstatus wan
ucode -S etc/homeproxy/scripts/generate_client.uc
log Warning: failed to restart dnsmasq, DNS-based routing may be stale.
ip tuntap add mode tun user root name singtun0
sleep 1s
ip link set singtun0 up
ip route replace default dev singtun0 table 100
ip rule add fwmark 102 lookup 100
procd_open_instance sing-box-c
procd_set_param command /usr/bin/sing-box
procd_append_param command run --config var/run/homeproxy/sing-box-c.json
procd_add_jail sing-box-c log procfs
procd_add_jail_mount var/run/homeproxy/sing-box-c.json
procd_add_jail_mount_rw var/run/homeproxy/sing-box-c.log
procd_add_jail_mount_rw etc/homeproxy/cache.db
procd_add_jail_mount etc/homeproxy/certs/
procd_add_jail_mount /etc/ssl/
procd_add_jail_mount /etc/localtime
procd_add_jail_mount /etc/TZ
procd_set_param capabilities /etc/capabilities/homeproxy.json
procd_set_param no_new_privs 1
procd_set_param user sing-box
procd_set_param group sing-box
procd_set_param limits core=unlimited
procd_set_param limits nofile=1000000 1000000
procd_set_param stderr 1
procd_set_param respawn
procd_close_instance
procd_open_instance log-cleaner
procd_set_param command etc/homeproxy/scripts/clean_log.sh
procd_set_param respawn
procd_close_instance
chown sing-box:sing-box var/run/homeproxy/sing-box-c.json var/run/homeproxy/sing-box-c.log etc/homeproxy/cache.db
ucode etc/homeproxy/scripts/firewall_pre.uc
utpl -S etc/homeproxy/scripts/firewall_post.ut
fw4 reload
sing-box version -n
log sing-box 1.14.0 started.
start rc=127
log Warning: failed to drop the auto-update cron entry.
log Warning: failed to restart cron.
config_load homeproxy
ip rule del fwmark 101 table 100
ip route del local 0.0.0.0/0 dev lo table 100
ip -6 rule del fwmark 101 table 100
ip -6 route del local ::/0 dev lo table 100
ip route del default dev singtun0 table 100
ip rule del fwmark 102 table 100
ip -6 route del default dev singtun0 table 100
ip -6 rule del fwmark 102 table 100
nft flush chain inet fw4 homeproxy_output_redir
nft delete chain inet fw4 homeproxy_output_redir

nft delete chain inet fw4 homeproxy_mangle_prerouting

nft delete chain inet fw4 homeproxy_mangle_output
nft flush chain inet fw4 homeproxy_mangle_tproxy
nft delete chain inet fw4 homeproxy_mangle_tproxy
nft flush chain inet fw4 homeproxy_mangle_tproxy_port
nft delete chain inet fw4 homeproxy_mangle_tproxy_port
nft flush chain inet fw4 homeproxy_mangle_lanac
nft delete chain inet fw4 homeproxy_mangle_lanac
nft flush chain inet fw4 homeproxy_mangle_mark
nft delete chain inet fw4 homeproxy_mangle_mark
nft flush chain inet fw4 homeproxy_mangle_tun
nft delete chain inet fw4 homeproxy_mangle_tun

nft delete chain inet fw4 homeproxy_mangle_tun_mark

nft delete set inet fw4 homeproxy_local_addr_v4
